## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Kissimmee, United States. It starts at 3301 Lake Cypress Rd, Kenansville.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> When the most famous indigenous animal is the alligator, you know you're in Florida! Grab a ticket to Wild Florida and drive along a wildlife superhighway for a close encounter with animals from the Sunshine State and all around the world.
>
> From the African savanna to the jungles of Asia, the North American plains, and of course the Everglades, you'll get up close and personal with some of the world's wildest creatures in large open habitats.
